text_block_list.text:
It's an important Grand Prix race. And the 
stage for a showdown with Tosen Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Uhm, taking place today is a clash of 
pride between Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate showdown where there's no 
turning back!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You'd better burn the sight of our battle 
deep into your eyes, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm going all out today too. Just watch 
me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, I'll grapple you head-on with 
everything I've got!!

Gold Ship must get more fired up when she 
has rivals to compete against. Just as I 
was thinking it was a good sign—

Splendid, truly SPLENDID! Now THIS is 
friendly rivalry!

Suddenly, a familiar voice called out from 
somewhere.

"However, the owner of the voice is 
nowhere to be seen... I decided to focus 
on the race for now."
